scope: Continuous mathematical model, not native instruction execution or historical backtest
risk_filters: Settled accepted observation; post-trade admission uses current price as an adverse control, no favorable EMA lag benefit.
depth: Recognized full-range tail only; post-trade/after-loss tail cannot exceed initial/preceding recognized tail in that run.
exclusions: daily buckets; enough elapsed time assumed

methods.trades: Conditional invariant integrated in log native sqrt-price; piecewise Gauss-Legendre order 12, grid step .01, split at band/cap boundaries; Newton inversion.
methods.validation: Independent piecewise CPMM closed forms; original native inventory endpoint; reciprocal-direction and reverse trades; independent Decimal sequential credit.

cap_convention: T is oracle/native mismatch threshold. Maximum price adjustment M=T^lambda. Main example lambda=.5,T=4 is M=2.
